text:
anna_sales: Heads-up — HelixCorp POC perf run needs scheduling. They want sustained 1k QPS for text-gen endpoints across us-west1 + eu-west1, p50 < 200ms, p99 < 700ms. Also asking for encrypted KV/HSM for keys and VPC peering. Need infra + security + pricing alignment this week. Who can drive infra?

mike_eng: I can take infra runbook. Quick q: models they'll use are ~7B and 13B variants, right? That changes GPU packing/instance type.

anna_sales: Correct — mostly 7B for baseline, 13B for edge-case tests. They want cost estimate for both.

mike_eng: OK. Plan sketch: warmup phase (10m), ramp to 1k QPS over 15m, soak 30m, ramp down. We'll measure p50/p95/p99 and throughput. Need load generator config and baseline token lengths.

julie_se: Security blockers: HelixCorp requires SAML SSO for Console access, KMS-integrated envelope encryption with customer HSM, and completed security questionnaire (I'll attach). VPC peering requires infra team's network acceptance.

sanjay_sre: HSM flow: we can demo KMS integration with our staging HSM, but production-grade customer HSM requires ops runbook and 48h window with their security team. For the POC demo we can stub encrypted keys but must label it as \"demo only\". Also watch for MTU issues on peered cross-region links.

emily_product: Pricing ask from Helix: they want estimated token cost for 1k QPS sustained for 30min on 7B and 13B, plus dedicated capacity monthly uplift if they go Dedicated. Need numbers by EOD tomorrow.

mike_eng: I'll produce a quick run cost calc. Need these from you: avg tokens per request (prompt+resp), and concurrency pattern (uniform vs poisson).

anna_sales: I have sample traces: avg request = 120 input tokens, 220 output tokens. Burstiness: ~80% steady, 20% short spikes (50–200% for 30s).

mike_eng: Perfect. For loadgen we'll use vegeta + custom client to preserve streaming. Example attack spec (we'll fine-tune):

```json
{
  \"duration\": \"00:55:00\",
  \"ramp\": \"00:25:00\",
  \"target_qps\": 1000,
  \"payload_template\": { \"prompt_tokens\": 120, \"max_tokens\": 220 }
}
```

mike_eng: We'll also capture KV-cache hit rate effect. With prefix caching expect ~15% token reduction on average.

julie_se: I'll start the security questionnaire and flag the HSM/SAML sections. Note: Helix insists on SOC2 type II evidence and a short pen-test summary. Do we have a slot for a SOC2 artifact share?

anna_sales: Yes — I can share the SOC2 pack from sales artifacts. Also they asked for data residency confirmation for eu-west1.

sanjay_sre: Multi-region: recommend routing primary to nearest region and fallback to other region if capacity spikes. For the test we'll pin routing to region-specific endpoints to isolate network effects. Watch for cross-region model sync time — quantized weights need ~30–90s to be warm depending on GPU config.

emily_product: For the pricing numbers: use our hosted per-token rates for 7B/13B and then show a Dedicated uplift option with a per-GPU monthly and amortized token cost. I'll pair with you mike to sanity check.

mike_eng: Will run an early smoke tonight (low qps) to validate the endpoints + streaming. Can someone confirm credentials/keys for Helix staging?

anna_sales: Helix sent a service account, keys in LastPass shared folder \"helix-poc\". I added you. @opsbot can you schedule the smoke deploy at 20:00 PST and notify #eng-runtime?

opsbot: Scheduled: perf-smoke-helix at 2026-03-21T03:00:00Z. Notifying #eng-runtime. :white_check_mark:

mike_eng: Thanks. After smoke we'll run the full ramp tomorrow. I'll post the runbook and the loadgen artifacts in this thread.

julie_se: Heads-up: SAML SSO setup will take ~2 business days with our IdP team if Helix provides metadata today. If they want SSO demo during POC, we need their metadata ASAP.

anna_sales: I'll chase Helix for SAML metadata and their pen-test executive summary. Also will ping Legal about the HSM note.

emily_product: Outcome asks to include: measured p50/p95/p99, cost per 1M tokens, recommended deployment (Hosted vs Dedicated), and known security gaps for production. Keep customer-ready slides.

mike_eng: Agreed. Initial metric thresholds: p50 < 200ms, p95 < 450ms, p99 < 700ms. If we miss p99 by >20% we run kernel/packing tweaks and re-run.

sanjay_sre: I'll join the run to monitor network and KMS telemetry. Also will collect metrics: qps, GPU util, mem, kernel latency, and network RTTs.

anna_sales: Great sync—thanks all. I'll update Helix with proposed schedule: smoke tonight, full run tomorrow midday. Will post Helix replies here.

(HelixCorp-Bot): HelixProd: Received proposed schedule. Confirming SAML metadata will be shared by EOD.

anna_sales: Awesome. Continued updates here. :rocket:
